description: This file defines the interface ProductOptionDao for data access operations related to ProductOption entities within the product attribute domain, extending generic data access functionality and providing methods for listing, retrieving by name, code, and read-only attributes in the context of a specific merchant store and language.

classes.name: ProductOptionDao
classes.description: This is an interface for data access operations on ProductOption entities, providing methods for listing, retrieving, updating, and managing product options in a store-specific and language-specific context.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of product options associated with a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product options matching a specified name within the context of a merchant store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product option or updates an existing one; may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Returns a list of read-only product options for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product option matching a specific code within a merchant store.
